The leak was in `src/jobs/processOrder.js:6-10`. It acquired a connection then released it only after `run()` succeeded — a rejected order (bad payload) skipped the release line entirely, so each failed order permanently ate one connection. That matches the worker log exactly: a run of `invalid order payload` errors that steadily push `pool in-use` from 2/5 up to 5/5, then `pool exhausted`, then the fatal exit at 2:06:35.

I wrapped the release in a `try/finally` so it always runs, win or lose. All 4 tests pass now, including the one that was catching this exact scenario.
